summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, announcing a public offering of simple, non-convertible debentures under the automatic registration rite (CVM Resolution 160). The initial issue amount is R$1.6 billion (1.6 million debentures at R$1,000 each), in up to two series, with ISIN codes provided. Coordinators include Itaú BBA, Santander, Bradesco BBI, and UBS BB. There are no special-situation elements — no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring — only a routine debt capital markets transaction. Thus, no further analysis applies.
